api.text:
Fields the design reads that GET /api/state does not have yet:

• card.handle – four to seven words, no label from the literature (the page falls back to the first clause of the hypothesis)
• status.stage – data | analysis | report | pdf | wall, so the trellis is read, never guessed
• status.by – who handed the finding to the desk, and when (the amber lamp)
• handoff.receipt – {at, sha256_matches} from the reviewers' side, so the wall can show a receipt coming back
• transport.kind – folder | rsync | tailscale | membrane
• status.recognised – already on the page as f.recognised; keep it

rules.text:
Three rules, kept:

1. Nothing on the page names a paper. Handles are the hypothesis in a few words.
2. The sealed record is a dashed amber ring. It opens only behind the confirm, for the humans on this side, and the glow lights only where a person decided.
3. Every state is read from the API. The second desk on the live board runs a DEMO script so the states can be seen without an agent; it says so on the desk.
